description: Your recent receipts, newest first: for each, its id, time, model, USDC charged, tokens and the upstream reference (kind charge, this key only), or the account's top-ups and refunds with their transaction and network. Read-only; page back with `before`. Free, but needs your API key.

before.description: Only entries older than this receipt id: pass the last id of the previous page.

kind.description: charge (default): what this key spent; topup: money added to the account; refund.

limit.description: How many, newest first. Defaults to 10.

name: get_receipts
title: Get receipts
